name: Unlabeled Sample Compression of the Three-Code Class
proof: A size-one improper scheme reconstructs $011$ from the empty code, $000$ from $\{x_0\}$, $001$ from $\{x_1\}$, and $101$ from $\{x_2\}$. For a realizable partial sample, use the empty code if it is consistent with $011$; otherwise use $\{x_0\}$ when it contains $x_0=0$, use $\{x_1\}$ when it contains $x_1=0$, and use $\{x_2\}$ in the remaining case. Each stated reconstruction is consistent with its assigned sample. Size zero is impossible because the full samples $000$ and $011$ disagree, whereas a zero-size scheme has one fixed reconstruction. The exhaustive check in $\texttt{sync/verify\_properness\_separation.py}$ independently verifies this value.
